gloss: to discard; to dispose of; to scrap

definitions.gloss: to discard; to dispose of; to scrap; to abolish
definitions.explanation: To get rid of something no longer needed, often through formal or proper disposal procedures. Also used for invalidating treaties, contracts, or rights.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{廃棄|はいき}する。
examples.english: I dispose of the old computer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賞味|しょうみ}{期限|きげん}→賞味期限：06076_shoumikigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{廃棄|はいき}して⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please discard food that has passed its expiration date.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれる→含む：01982_fukumu⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦シュレッダー→シュレッダー：07492_shureddaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{廃棄|はいき}し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Documents containing personal information must be disposed of with a shredder.

notes:
{廃棄|はいき}する is a formal word for disposal, implying proper procedures rather than simply throwing something away. It is common in business, environmental, and legal contexts. When applied to treaties or agreements, it means to abrogate or invalidate them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{産業|さんぎょう}{廃棄|はいき}{物|ぶつ}→産業廃棄物：19064_sangyouhaikibutsu⟧: industrial waste
- ⟦{廃棄|はいき}{物|ぶつ}→廃棄物：04634_haikibutsu⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: waste disposal
- ⟦{核|かく}→核：13127_kaku⟧⟦{廃棄|はいき}→廃棄：12482_haiki⟧: nuclear disarmament
- ⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{廃棄|はいき}する: to abrogate a treaty
- ⟦{不法|ふほう}→不法：11361_fuhou⟧⟦{廃棄|はいき}→廃棄：12482_haiki⟧: illegal dumping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to throw away — everyday word for discarding, less formal
- ⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispose of; to deal with — broader, includes disposal but also disciplinary action
- ⟦{撤去|てっきょ}する→撤去する：21321_tekkyosuru⟧: to remove; to dismantle — focuses on physical removal of structures or equipment
